description: This is a controller source file for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines a class 'Cod' handling 'Cash on Delivery' payment method, including methods for displaying the payment page ('index') and confirming an order ('confirm').

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class handling Cash on Delivery payment method in OpenCart, managing the display and confirmation of payment.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, prepares data, and renders the payment view for Cash on Delivery.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes confirmation of the COD payment, updating order status, and redirecting to success or failure pages.
